smell_validity.evidence: The scheduler now implements engines' policy: sc_plan duplicates index's six matching rules, sc_profile rebuilds the deleted siprofiler aggregation, sc_logmaint re-derives wal readiness and sweeps the manager's list. scprofiler's layout becomes the deleted engine record. Prefix discipline makes the fault unmistakable without the label, and the split rotation rule (decided in scheduler, executed in wal) demonstrates the cost.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Repair restores coupled ownership: index matching, statistics computation and log readiness would change in one home again. The injected state forces cross-component edits with convention-enforced agreement — readiness decided in scheduler while rotation executes in wal, and scprofiler now solely defines index metrics. Three real stale-behavior drivers make a lasting trap, though gains stay subsystem-scoped rather than architecture-wide.

development_plausibility.evidence: Moved code keeps original conditions, comments, trace strings and idiosyncrasies (goto match, sslikely), and new sc_plan/sc_profile/sc_log modules use standard preambles, sibling naming and full include sets. Behavior is preserved exactly across both caller classes. The investigation-driven motivation, kept-versus-moved asymmetry (wal acts, index bookkeeping) and exported sw_remove read as genuine compromise, not task scaffolding.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The natural prompt identifies all three symptom families, the target home (engines through their own interface), scheduler's legitimate residue (ordering, admission, dispatch, retry, trace), secondary surfaces (declarations, headers, build lists, the record's reporting consumer), completeness demand and behavior/test gates. Realistic partial cleanups are ruled out without prescribing an implementation; small boundaries like the trace renderer's home stay unresolved.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three purposes each need code-supported decisions: restoring index selection (six matching rules, locked-node retry, node locking, lock placement); recreating an engine-side statistics record with its own lock protocol and sedb home; splitting log maintenance back into wal readiness and sweep while restoring trace placement and the sw_remove export. Admission-gated, direct and control callers differ further.

localization_burden.evidence: Scope crosses scheduler, index, wal and environment: classifying scprofiler's added fields and sedb's lost member requires combining the record with se_conf's nine status leaves; classifying wal's retained gc and rotate requires their non-scheduler command callers. Look-alikes (admission gate, si_planner bookkeeping) need exclusion. No alias, callback-registration or configuration-selection mechanism is evidenced, so higher levels lack support.

repair_coordination.evidence: Rules interact: restoring engine ownership forces redesigning the admission gate whose saturation SI_PRETRY collides with locked-node SI_PRETRY, and re-splitting the merged snapshot redistributes scheduler-mutex versus index-lock sequencing. Halves break separately — reverting scprofiler without se_conf's leaves silently reads zeros; restoring wal readiness without wiring rotation leaves maintenance dead.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: No uniform rule re-homes two clusters: inputs differ (scdb*, sc*, swmanager* with worker and flag), side effects differ (node locking, spinlocked list unlinking, mutexed state copy), and trace is emitted before the enable check. Reconnecting existing helpers covers only wal's sweep; verbatim relocation drags scheduler types into engines; delegation shims leave the foreign record.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Wrong edits compile and pass ordinary runs: dropping the admission gate breaks per-queue worker limits only under load; splitting the snapshot wrongly yields stale or zero status on later reads; mis-ordered enable and trace checks change maintenance decisions silently. Level 4 needs test evidence that a hidden path is unchecked; no test contents are supplied.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
